title: Right-now summary writes do not sync to the project overlay, so new issues' summaries are shadowed in the feed
description: Dogfooding kbs now against this board found that persist_right_now_summary (Epic 5) writes the right_now_summary to the canonical project/issues path resolved by load_issue_from_project, but kanbus create (Epic 4) also writes new issues to the project/.overlay/issues overlay. The overlay copy stays stale (no summary) and shadows the fresh canonical copy in list_issues, so kbs now shows '(no right-now summary)' for new issues even though the summary exists on disk. Fix: regen (persist_right_now_summary) must write to the same path the gate used (the overlay-aware path), or the gate must keep the overlay in sync with right_now_summary writes. Without this fix the feature appears broken for all new issues (their summaries never show in the feed).
right_now_summary: New issue summaries are saved in the wrong location, so the project feed shows none.
